name: control-plane-denied
note: The original places on a controlPlane machine set even when allowWorkloadScheduling is false, as long as the workload names it; the Go port rejects that placement.

response.error: Workload "workload" is not schedulable. All available MachineSets are too small to run this workload. Minimum required: at least 102 CPU and 504 GB memory.

name: fits-by-memory
note: The original creates the first machine set named in usesMachines without rechecking fit, placing a 20 GB service on an 8 GB node; the Go port picks a machine set that fits.

name: service-zones-ignored
note: The original spreads Service.Zones replicas over separate zones; the Go port ignores Service.Zones and reports a single zone.
